description: Codex-native reviewerAgent commit gate, liveness tracking, and stopContinue supervisor.

hooks.command: reviewer_python=python3; if [ -e "$HOME/.codex/reviewer-agent-codex/python-path" ] || [ -L "$HOME/.codex/reviewer-agent-codex/python-path" ]; then IFS= read -r reviewer_python < "$HOME/.codex/reviewer-agent-codex/python-path" || reviewer_python=; fi; "$reviewer_python" -c 'import os,pathlib,sys;r=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);p=r.parent;q=sys.argv[2];c=[r]+(sorted((x for x in p.iterdir() if x.is_dir()),key=lambda x:x.name,reverse=True) if p.is_dir() else [])+[pathlib.Path.home()/"plugins"/p.name];s=next(x/q for x in c if (x/q).is_file());os.execv(sys.executable,[sys.executable,str(s)]+sys.argv[3:])' "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" "scripts/hook_prompt.py"
